name: Executive Full Body Health Checkup
tagline: Comprehensive 75+ Parameter Screening for Complete Peace of Mind
description: Our flagship full body checkup engineered for early risk detection of lifestyle conditions, organ wellness, metabolic health, and nutritional deficiencies.
recommendedFor: Men & Women Aged 18+

name: Anaemia Mini Profile
tagline: Iron, Ferritin, Transferrin & Vitamin B12 / Folate Evaluation
description: Essential diagnostic profile designed to evaluate iron deficiency, microcytic anemia, serum ferritin reserves, transferrin saturation, and vitamin B12/folate levels.
recommendedFor: Individuals experiencing chronic fatigue, weakness, dizziness, low hemoglobin

name: Arthritis Profile
tagline: Comprehensive Joint, Uric Acid & Autoimmune Inflammation Screening
description: Evaluates rheumatoid factor, Anti-CCP, ANA, ASO, and uric acid alongside complete hemogram and urine analysis to differentiate rheumatoid arthritis, gout, and systemic inflammation.
recommendedFor: Patients with joint pain, morning stiffness, swelling, or suspected autoimmune arthritis

name: Breast Cancer Profile
tagline: High-Sensitivity Chemiluminescence Tumor Marker Evaluation
description: Specialized serum tumor marker evaluation measuring CA 15.3, Carcinoembryonic Antigen (CEA), Beta HCG, and Acid Phosphatase Total to support clinical oncology screening.
recommendedFor: Women undergoing diagnostic follow-up, high-risk screening, or oncologist consultation

name: Cardiac Profile
tagline: Essential Cardiac Enzymes & Total Cholesterol Screening
description: Targeted heart health panel evaluating total cholesterol, CPK, LDH, and SGOT enzymes for baseline myocardial tissue status and metabolic risk.
recommendedFor: Individuals wanting baseline heart enzyme and lipid screening

name: Cardiac Risk Profile
tagline: Advanced Myocardial Strain & Cardiovascular Risk Biomarkers
description: Comprehensive cardiac risk panel measuring Troponin I & T, BNP, hs-CRP, Homocysteine, Myoglobin, CK-MB, and CK-NAC for early detection of ischemic heart disease.
recommendedFor: Individuals with chest discomfort history, hypertension, family cardiac history, high stress

name: Diabetes Monitoring Maxi Profile
tagline: Gold Standard HPLC Glycemic, C-Peptide, Insulin & Microalbumin Panel
description: Designed for thorough diabetes management. Features HbA1c by HPLC, Fasting/PP Glucose, Serum Insulin, C-Peptide, Microalbuminuria, BUN, Creatinine, and Lipid Profile.
fastingRequirement: 10-12 Hours Fasting Required for Fasting Sample
recommendedFor: Patients with Type 1 or Type 2 Diabetes, metabolic syndrome, or monitoring therapy

name: Infertility Profile - IV
tagline: Core Pituitary & Ovarian Reproductive Hormone Evaluation
description: Baseline fertility assessment measuring LH, FSH, Prolactin, Estradiol (E2), and Total Testosterone to evaluate follicular development and ovulatory balance.
fastingRequirement: Morning Sample Recommended (Day 2-3 of Cycle for Females)
recommendedFor: Couples planning pregnancy, women evaluating irregular cycles or ovulatory disorders

name: General Health Check
tagline: Vital Organs, Blood Picture, Lipids & Viral Serology Clearance
description: Essential preventive health check covering Kidney parameters (Creatinine, Urea), Lipid Profile, Complete Blood Picture, ESR, Blood Grouping, Urine Examination, HIV, and HBsAg.
recommendedFor: Routine annual health assessment for all age groups

name: Hepatitis Profile
tagline: Comprehensive Viral Hepatitis A, B, C & E Diagnostic Screen
description: Complete serological panel testing for acute, chronic, and immunity markers: HAV-IgM/Total, Anti-HBe, HBeAg, Anti-HBs, HBsAg, HCV Antibody, Anti-HBc (IgM/Total), and HEV (IgM/IgG).
recommendedFor: Patients with jaundice, elevated liver enzymes, viral hepatitis exposure, pre-vaccination assessment

name: HIV-Early Detection Profile
tagline: 4th Generation Dual Antibody & P24 Antigen Early Screen
description: Ultra-sensitive 4th-generation assay identifying HIV-1 and HIV-2 antibodies alongside the P24 capsid antigen, significantly narrowing the diagnostic window period.
recommendedFor: Post-exposure assessment, early detection window, high clinical confidentiality

name: HIV Profile
tagline: Confirmatory Western Blot, CD4/CD8 Count & RT-PCR Viral Load
description: Comprehensive reference panel offering Western Blot confirmation, CD3/CD4/CD8 immune staging, and quantitative RT-Real Time PCR viral load measurement.
recommendedFor: Patients requiring definitive confirmation, immune staging, or therapy response tracking

name: Infectious Profile
tagline: Rapid Blood-Borne Infection Screen (HIV, HBsAg, HCV, VDRL)
description: Standard four-parameter infection panel screening for major blood-borne and sexually transmitted pathogens: HIV 1&2, Hepatitis B Surface Antigen, Hepatitis C Antibody, and Syphilis (VDRL).
recommendedFor: Pre-operative fitness, pre-marital checkup, healthcare employment, or routine blood screening

name: Infertility Male Profile
tagline: Comprehensive Male Hormones, Semen Analysis & Chlamydia Screen
description: Holistic male fertility evaluation combining pituitary and androgen hormones, semen routine and culture, sperm antibodies, Chlamydia serologies, CBC, sugars, and renal profile.
fastingRequirement: 10-12 Hours Fasting Required; 3-5 Days Abstinence for Semen Sample
recommendedFor: Men investigating reproductive health, couples evaluating conception difficulties

name: Infertility Female Profile
tagline: AMH Ovarian Reserve, Gonadotropins, Chlamydia & Complete Vitals
description: In-depth female fertility workup measuring Anti-Mullerian Hormone (AMH), FSH, LH, Prolactin, TSH, Sperm Antibodies, Chlamydia serologies, CBC, Blood Grouping, and metabolic vitals.
recommendedFor: Women planning conception, assessing ovarian reserve, or investigating recurrent implantation issues

name: Menopause Maxi Profile
tagline: Hormonal Transition, Bone Minerals, Thyroid & Lipid Panel
description: Comprehensive evaluation designed for perimenopausal and menopausal women. Evaluates estrogen decline (E2), gonadotropins (FSH, LH), thyroid health, bone minerals (Calcium, Phosphorus), and lipids.
recommendedFor: Women aged 40+ experiencing hot flushes, mood changes, irregular cycles, or joint stiffness

name: Obesity Profile
tagline: Adipokines (Leptin, Adiponectin), Cortisol & Metabolic Panel
description: Specialized profile examining hormonal and adipokine drivers of weight gain: Adiponectin, Leptin, Morning Cortisol, Thyroid Profile, FBS, Lipids, Electrolytes, Creatinine, and Uric Acid.
recommendedFor: Individuals struggling with unexplained weight gain, metabolic syndrome, or pre-bariatric workup

name: Osteoporosis Maxi Profile
tagline: Advanced Bone Turnover Markers, Vitamin D, PTH & Beta-Crosslaps
description: High-precision assessment of bone density and turnover: Parathyroid Hormone (PTH), 25-OH Vitamin D, Osteocalcin, P1NP, Beta-2 Crosslaps, DPD, Estradiol, Calcium, and Phosphorus.
recommendedFor: Post-menopausal women, senior citizens, patients with osteoporosis or fracture history

name: Parathyroid Profile
tagline: Intact PTH, Ionised Calcium, Urine Calcium & Magnesium Panel
description: Diagnostic evaluation for hyper- or hypoparathyroidism correlating intact PTH hormone with total serum calcium, ionised calcium, urine calcium, magnesium, and alkaline phosphatase.
recommendedFor: Patients with abnormal calcium levels, kidney stones, bone pain, or parathyroid adenoma suspicion

name: Pancreatic Profile
tagline: Serum Amylase, Lipase, Bilirubin & Complete Hemogram
description: Essential diagnostic profile to assess acute or chronic pancreatic inflammation, measuring serum amylase and lipase with CBC, serum calcium, and bilirubin.
recommendedFor: Patients presenting with severe upper abdominal pain, nausea, or pancreatitis follow-up

name: Prostate Cancer Profile
tagline: Total & Free PSA, PSA Ratio, Prostatic Acid Phosphatase & Beta-2M
description: Dedicated screening for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH) and prostate malignancies. Measures Total PSA, Free PSA, Free/Total Ratio, Prostatic Acid Phosphatase, Ferritin, and Beta-2 Microglobulin.
fastingRequirement: No Fasting Required (Avoid vigorous exercise / cycling prior to test)
recommendedFor: Men aged 45+ or those experiencing urinary frequency, hesitancy, or weak stream

name: Pre-Operative Maxi Profile
tagline: Mandatory Pre-Surgical Diagnostic Safety & Fitness Clearance
description: Comprehensive pre-anesthesia profile including Blood Grouping, Complete Blood Count, Urine Routine, Renal function (BUN, Creatinine), Fasting Glucose, and Viral Screening (HIV, HBsAg, HCV).
recommendedFor: Patients scheduled for surgical interventions, daycare procedures, or endoscopic surgeries

name: Sexually transmitted Diseases (STD) Maxi Profile
tagline: Molecular Multiplex PCR for HPV, Chlamydia, HSV & HIV-1 RNA
description: Ultra-sensitive molecular nucleic acid amplification (NAAT/PCR) detecting high-risk Human Papillomavirus (HPV) DNA, Chlamydia Trachomatis DNA, Herpes Simplex Virus (HSV) DNA, and HIV-1 RNA across 24 parameters.
recommendedFor: Complete confidential sexual health screening, molecular pathogen verification

testsIncluded: HPV - DNA (High Risk & Low Risk Genotypes)

name: Thalassemia Profile
tagline: HPLC Hemoglobin Electrophoresis, Iron & Cardiolipin Antibodies
description: Definitive profile for hemoglobinopathies: Hemoglobin Electrophoresis by HPLC, Iron Profile (Iron, TIBC, %Transferrin), Vitamin B12, and Anti-Cardiolipin Antibodies.
recommendedFor: Pre-marital screening, family history of thalassemia, microcytic hypochromic anemia unresponsive to iron

name: Thyroid Comprehensive Profile
tagline: Total, Free & Autoimmune Antibodies (Anti-TPO & Anti-TG)
description: Complete 7-parameter thyroid evaluation measuring active hormones and autoimmune markers: T3, T4, TSH, Free T3 (FT3), Free T4 (FT4), Anti-Thyroperoxidase (ATPO), and Anti-Thyroglobulin (ATG).
recommendedFor: Suspected Hashimoto's thyroiditis, Graves' disease, nodules, or refractory thyroid disorders

name: TORCH 10 Profile (IgG & IgM)
tagline: Antenatal Congenital Infection Screen (Toxo, Rubella, CMV, HSV)
description: Critical prenatal antibody panel testing both IgG and IgM for Toxoplasmosis, Rubella, Cytomegalovirus (CMV), and Herpes Simplex Virus 1 & 2 to prevent congenital complications.
recommendedFor: Pre-conception checkup, early pregnancy screening, recurrent pregnancy loss workup

name: Vitamin B Complex profile
tagline: Complete Water-Soluble B-Vitamin Coenzyme Assessment
description: Comprehensive profiling of essential B vitamins vital for cellular energy, nerve health, and RBC synthesis: Vitamin B1 (Thiamine), B2 (Riboflavin), B6 (Pyridoxine), B9 (Folate), and B12 (Cobalamin).
recommendedFor: Neuropathy, chronic fatigue, malabsorption, vegetarian diets, or memory concerns
